How Much Does Umrah Cost from Canada in 2026?

If you’re planning Umrah from Canada, one of the first questions you’ll ask is: how much will it cost? The answer depends on several factors — your departure city, travel dates, hotel tier, and the type of package you choose.
This guide breaks down the real cost of Umrah from Canada in 2026, including what’s included in a package, what’s not, and how to get the best value for your budget.

At Matchless Travels, we offer three tiers of Umrah packages departing from Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ). All prices are in Canadian dollars (CAD) and are per person based on double occupancy.

items: Return flights from Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ) to Jeddah or Madinah

blocks.text: Factors That Affect Umrah Package Prices from Canada

Umrah prices vary significantly by season. The most expensive periods are Ramadan (especially the last 10 nights), school holidays, and the months immediately before Hajj. The most affordable months are typically May through September (excluding Ramadan) and January through February.

Hotels within 200 metres of Masjid al-Haram in Makkah cost significantly more than hotels 500 metres or 1 kilometre away. Our Diamond tier places you in the closest hotels available; Silver tier uses quality hotels within a 5–10 minute walk.
Standard Umrah packages from Canada are typically 10–14 nights. Longer packages (21–28 nights) are available and priced accordingly.

Direct flights from Toronto to Jeddah or Madinah are not always available. Many packages connect through Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi, or Istanbul. The number of stops and airline selected affects the price.
Families and groups of 6 or more may qualify for group discounts. Contact us to discuss group Umrah pricing.
Is Umrah Cheaper to Book Directly or Through a Travel Agency?
Booking through a TICO-registered Canadian travel agency like Matchless Travels is almost always the smarter choice. Here’s why:

items: Visa processing — We handle the Saudi Umrah visa on your behalf. Doing it independently requires navigating the Nusuk platform and specific document requirements
Hotel proximity knowledge — We know which hotels are genuinely close to the Haram vs. which ones market themselves misleadingly
Flight coordination — We bundle flights and hotels so your timing between Makkah and Madinah is properly coordinated
Consumer protection — As a TICO-registered agency, your booking is protected under Ontario’s Travel Industry Act
Support on the ground — If something goes wrong with your hotel or transfer, you have someone to call

blocks.text: How much spending money do I need for Umrah in 2026?

Beyond your package cost, most pilgrims budget $500–$1,500 CAD for meals, shopping, and personal expenses over a 10–14 night trip. Makkah and Madinah have abundant food options at all price points near the Haram.
Do I need travel insurance for Umrah?
Travel insurance is strongly recommended. It covers trip cancellations, medical emergencies, and lost luggage. We can recommend appropriate travel insurance for your Umrah journey.
Can I pay for my Umrah package in installments?
Yes. Matchless Travels offers flexible payment plans. Contact us at (289) 643-6663 to discuss deposit and installment options for your package.
When should I book to get the best price?
We recommend booking at least 3–4 months in advance for regular season travel, and 5–6 months in advance for Ramadan Umrah. Early booking secures better hotel proximity and flight availability.
Are there additional fees for Umrah from Canada?
The Saudi government does not currently charge a separate Umrah fee for first-time pilgrims. There are standard visa processing fees included in all Matchless Travels packages.
